column1: # PDUs that tests/wireshark.rs has tshark dissect and compares with what the crate reads of them, field by
# field (compare.py, along mapping.tsv; known.tsv explains each difference). One PDU a row, by tabs: where it
# comes from and what it shows, its octets. Each comes from a lab capture of a core or a RAN simulator, a
# fixture of the crate or a test of the crate; there is one of each shape of message that both read alike,
# and some of each difference that known.tsv explains. None holds a key.
